errors: None on this page; it contains only a bibliographic or archival note. The note's claim that section 5 onwards is unpublished is a cataloguer's assertion. It is plausible but would need checking against the printed text of Collected Papers no. 10.

results.what: Archival note: the manuscript folio 56 corresponds to Ramanujan's published paper no. 10 (Collected Papers p. 50), except that section 5 onwards is unpublished.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is only a cataloguer's note linking the manuscript to a known published paper of Ramanujan (Collected Papers no. 10). It contains no mathematics. The only mild interest is the remark that part of the manuscript went unpublished, which concerns the previous folio, not this one.

checkable.asserts: Context check for item (1) on the previous folio, which the note refers to. Multiplying through by n^6(1+a/n)^3(1+b/n)^3, the factorisation becomes ((n+a)^3+(a+b)^3)((n+b)^3+(a+b)^3) = (n+a+2b)(n+2a+b)(n^2-z^2)(n^2-zbar^2), with z = ((a-b)+i(a+b)sqrt3)/2.
Context check: |z|^2 = a^2+ab+b^2, which is the denominator factor in item (3) of the previous folio.

transcription_corrections: The machine transcription is essentially correct.
Top-right annotation: the first word, read as "with[?]", appears to be "with". The archive reference is "Add Ms a 94^18 (56)", with the superscript 18 followed by (56).
Main text: "This is 10. p50 but from section 5 onwards is not published". Here "10. p50" refers to paper no. 10, page 50, of Ramanujan's Collected Papers.
